content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Overview

content_blocks.text: This Regulation allows suppliers to rely on the capacities of other entities when bidding for a particular contract, in order to meet the contracting authority’s requirements in relation to economic and financial standing and technical and professional ability, regardless of the legal relationship between them.
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Overview

content_blocks.text: Where a supplier seeks to rely on the capacities of other entities, it must prove to the contracting authority that the necessary resources will be available, e.g. through a commitment from those entities.
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Overview

content_blocks.text: The contracting authority must also verify whether the relied-upon entities meet the relevant selection criteria and if there are any grounds for exclusion, in which case there may be a requirement to replace the relied-upon entity.
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Overview

content_blocks.text: In certain circumstances, a contracting authority may require that specific critical tasks be performed directly by the supplier bidding for the contract.
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Suppliers may rely on third parties in order to satisfy the selection requirements where they are able to demonstrate that they have at their disposal the necessary resources of the relied upon entity.
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should:
heading_path: Reliance on the capacities of other entities

content_blocks.text: ensure that there is adequate evidence to demonstrate that the supplier has at its disposal the necessary resources of the relied upon entity.
